data.body:
Independent verification, 2026-10-27 (bug sweep). The ticket's premise no longer holds on current main.

Experiment (read-only): with REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR=/var/lib/rebar/gate-scratch and no marker files, scratch_unavailable_detail() returns a refusal ("...configured as the dedicated scratch volume but .gate-scratch-required and .gate-scratch-mounted are absent..."). With REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR unset it returns None, so laptops and CI runners are unchanged.

Cause of the change: commit be40fd250fd (rebar-ticket 8ea3-3750-6772-4ac6) made the canonical gate-scratch path an arming declaration, so a volume attached after first boot (user_data.sh never wrote the marker) is refused rather than admitted.

AC1: infra/compose/docker-compose.yml sets REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR to the canonical path for both the gate-running service and the review-bot, and infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh passes it as well. tests/unit/test_gate_scratch_volume_aa40.py (18 tests) pins compose/gate-admission agreement and passes.
AC2: no new mechanism; the existing path constant is reused.
AC3 (sequencing behind the dcc3 remediation): moot once the refusal is armed by host config.
AC4 (three-place duplication of the expected mount set): not resolved here; moved to its own ticket.

Closing as obsolete.
